title: Workmanship Warranties Certificate Conditions: Term, Change of Ownership and Voiding
content:
## Condition 1. Term

A Workmanship Warranties plan that lasts as long as the customer on file owns the vehicle has no term and runs while the customer on file owns the vehicle. A plan with a term runs its term months, in calendar months, from the date the term counts from, the issued date.

Months are calendar months from the issued date. When the issued day does not exist in the end month, the term ends on that month's last day, and the term's end date is still covered.

## Condition 2. Change of ownership

Where the plan ends coverage when the customer on file no longer owns the vehicle, coverage ends when the vehicle record shows an owned-through date. The plan does not pass to a later owner, and a later owner's report is refused.

## Condition 3. Voiding

Where the plan voids coverage on outside alteration, coverage is voided when the warrantied work is altered or re-repaired outside the network. Where the plan voids coverage on a later total loss, coverage is voided when the vehicle is declared a total loss in a later loss.

## Condition 4. Closed coverages

A coverage already redeemed, expired, voided or ended stays so.

## How each ending shows on the coverage

| Ending | Status the coverage takes | Closing date on the coverage |
|---|---|---|
| A fixed-term plan reaches the end of its term | expired | the day after the last covered day |
| The vehicle record shows an owned-through date | ended by sale | the vehicle's owned-through date |
| The warrantied work is altered or re-repaired outside the network | voided, reason altered by others | the date recorded |
| The vehicle is declared a total loss in a later loss | voided, reason later total loss | the date recorded |

## Worked term dates (hypothetical)

| Plan term | Issued date | Last covered day | Status from |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 months | 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | expired from 16 March 2026 |
| 12 months | 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 (29 February does not exist in that month) | expired from 1 March 2025 |
| 24 months | 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2026 | expired from 1 September 2026 |

In each row the end date itself is still covered, and the closing date recorded on expiry is the day after it.

## Points of judgement

- A lifetime-while-owned plan has no end date by term; while the vehicle record shows no owned-through date and no voiding event has been recorded, it runs.
- Once the vehicle record shows an owned-through date, coverage under a plan that ends on sale has ended; a report from a later owner of that vehicle is refused, because the plan does not pass to a later owner.
- A coverage that is already voided does not return to active, and an expired coverage is not reopened: a coverage already redeemed, expired, voided or ended stays so.
